# AnGaMa Pokédex

> Der AnGaMa Pokédex ist ein kostenloser deutsch- und englischsprachiger Pokémon Explorer von AnGaMa, dem Gaming-Creator hinter den Profilen AnGaMa666 und AnGaMaVT.

Canonical URL: https://pokedex.byangama.de/
Creator and publisher: AnGaMa
Twitch: https://www.twitch.tv/angama666
TikTok: https://www.tiktok.com/@angamavt
Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/angama666/
X / Twitter: https://x.com/AnGaMa666
GitHub profile: https://github.com/AnGaMa666
Source repository: https://github.com/AnGaMa666/Pokedex_Vue
Primary language: German
Additional language: English

## Identity mapping

- AnGaMa is the creator and publisher name.
- AnGaMa666 is the official account name on Twitch, Instagram, X and GitHub.
- AnGaMaVT is the official account name on TikTok.
- The AnGaMa Pokédex at https://pokedex.byangama.de/ is an official AnGaMa project.

## Main features

- National Pokédex with species, forms, variants and regional numbers
- Pokémon profiles with types, abilities, evolutions and catch rates
- Move directory with damage classes and learn methods
- Item, berry, Poké Ball and special-item directories
- Routes and wild encounters grouped by game version
- EV, IV/DV and nature calculations
- Competitive team builder
- Light mode, dark mode, shiny sprites and selectable sprite sources

## Data source and affiliation

The application uses data from https://pokeapi.co/.
It is an independent fan project and is not affiliated with Nintendo, GAME FREAK or The Pokémon Company.
Pokémon and related names belong to their respective rights holders.
